description: A finite state machine over Forge's delivery phases -- deterministic transition table for the Forge outer loop. Shared by the Claude Code, Codex, and opencode runtimes through .scripts/forge-control.py. Rules are evaluated in array order and the FIRST match wins; every phase's deny rules precede its allow rules, so a hard stop cannot be out-competed by a permissive rule later in the list. Rule ids are cited by both SKILL.md files -- changing a ruling here changes it for every runtime.

computed_inputs.consecutive_failures: Replayed from events.jsonl per phase; never accepted from the caller.
computed_inputs.drift: Repo HEADs at decision time compared against the heads recorded by the most recent review advance; never accepted from the caller.
computed_inputs.reviewed_heads: Persisted by the review transition, consumed by the ship gate.

rules.reason: Provider profile resolved and persisted.
Architect failed twice; stop and report artifacts so far.
rules.source: SKILL.md Failure & stop conditions: 'Architect fails twice -> stop'

rules.reason: First architect failure; one re-run with the specific gap named is permitted.
Fewer than two council seats returned; fall back to the solo chief and record it.
rules.source: SKILL.md Phase A: 'council-failed (<2 seats) -> fall back to solo chief, noted'

rules.reason: Architecture contract complete and analyze-clean.
Every affected repo has a worktree on feat/<id>.
Two consecutive broken implement runs; stop and report rather than thrash.
rules.source: SKILL.md Phase I: 'Two consecutive broken runs -> stop and report; don't thrash'

rules.reason: First broken run; re-run with resumeFromRunId after addressing the blocker.
A repo implementer reported blocked; finish others, report the blocker, never silently drop a repo.
rules.source: SKILL.md Failure & stop conditions: 'A repo's implementer reports blocked'

rules.reason: --skip-verify given; Phase V and V' are skipped and must be recorded in bold in the ledger and every PR body.
rules.source: SKILL.md Phase V: '--skip-verify skips this phase and V' entirely'

rules.reason: All waves implemented, contracts checked, gates audited.
Failures survived the fix rounds; not shippable.
rules.source: SKILL.md Phase V: 'fail -> failures survived the fix rounds; stop and report'

rules.reason: Well-known ports occupied in exclusive mode. Nothing was killed and no data touched; free the ports and --resume --from verify. Never ship around it.
rules.source: SKILL.md Phase V: 'Never ship around it'

rules.reason: Tracks produced no signal but --skip-verify was explicitly given.
rules.source: SKILL.md Phase V: 'env-degraded -> treat as fail unless the user said --skip-verify'

rules.reason: Some tracks produced no signal; treated as fail unless --skip-verify was given.
rules.source: SKILL.md Phase V: 'env-degraded -> treat as fail unless the user said --skip-verify'

rules.reason: Passing, but high-level at-risk/unmitigated register entries carry forward as residual findings -- report, do not bury.
rules.source: SKILL.md Phase V: 'at-risk/unmitigated entries of level high are treated like residual findings'

rules.reason: Live pyramid green; reviewers will read live-verified code.
Architect declared no runnable tracks (docs/infra-only); the explicit decision is recorded.
rules.source: SKILL.md Phase V: 'not-applicable -> proceed; the ledger records the explicit decision'

rules.reason: Unresolved high-severity security findings. NEVER ship. Risk acceptance is the operator's, never an agent's.
rules.source: SKILL.md Phase R: 'security-hold -> never ship'

rules.reason: Residual severity above medium; not shippable.
rules.source: SKILL.md Phase R: 'Anything higher -> do not ship; report'

rules.reason: Security residuals never qualify for the proceed-as-tracked-debt path regardless of severity.
rules.source: SKILL.md Phase R: 'proceeding is allowed only for non-security residuals of severity <= medium'

rules.reason: Non-security residuals at or below medium; proceed only as tracked debt listed in the ledger and every PR body.
rules.source: SKILL.md Phase R: 'proceeding is allowed only for non-security residuals of severity <= medium; list them in the PR bodies and the ledger as tracked debt'

rules.reason: Unverified findings above medium severity; not shippable.
rules.source: SKILL.md Phase R: 'clean-unverified or residual -> proceeding is allowed only for non-security residuals of severity <= medium ... Anything higher -> do not ship; report'

rules.reason: Security findings that could not be verified never qualify for the tracked-debt path.
rules.source: SKILL.md Phase R: 'only for non-security residuals' -- binds clean-unverified and residual jointly

rules.reason: Findings could not be verified to exhaustion; same tracked-debt handling as residual.
rules.source: SKILL.md Phase R: 'clean-unverified or residual -> ... list them in the PR bodies and the ledger as tracked debt'

rules.reason: Review clean and no code changed; Phase V evidence stands, V' is skipped.
rules.source: SKILL.md Phase V-prime: 'If R applied no fixes, skip V'

rules.reason: Review clean but fixes were applied; scoped live regression is required.
Scoped regression green.
No runnable tracks to regress.
Regression non-pass is non-shippable; same strict handling as Phase V.
rules.source: SKILL.md Phase V-prime: 'Anything else -> same strict handling as Phase V'

rules.reason: Worktree or spec SHAs moved after the panel's verdict. Re-arm a scoped spec-compliance review (security rides along, non-removable) before this is treated as review-clean again. Flagged rather than hard: the prose defines this as a recoverable re-arm, and ship_gate's live no-drift check -- recomputed from real HEADs on every call -- remains the fail-closed authority.
rules.source: SKILL.md Failure & stop conditions: 'Post-review drift gate'

rules.reason: A dirty worktree at ship time is a defect: implementers commit their work.
rules.source: SKILL.md Phase S: 'a dirty tree here is a defect'

rules.reason: Clean worktrees, shippable review status, passing or not-applicable verification, no drift. Push and open PRs; never merge.
PRs open; human gates remain open by design.

ship_preconditions.description: Enforced by forge-control.py ship_gate(), which the PreToolUse hooks and the per-worktree git pre-push hook both call. Each id maps to a check in that function; a test asserts none is silently dropped.

checks.detail: cached state does not contradict shippability
state.json does not contradict the append-only journal (evidence of hand-editing)
no hard blocker open in the append-only journal
intact path from initial, incl. a review and a verify that CONCLUDED (severity != hard) rather than merely being entered -- or an explicit verify skip
worktree HEADs match the SHAs recorded at review time
no uncommitted changes in any feature worktree
journal belongs to this feature and no other ledger holds it
every feature commit carries a signature (deferred signing must actually have run)
the journal matches the immutable refs/forge/<feature-id> commit that recorded each transition
